# Transitions

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Transitions move issues between statuses in Jira's workflow. Available
transitions depend on the project's workflow configuration and the current
status of the issue. Use `jira transition list` to see what is available
for a given issue.

## jira transition list

List available transitions for an issue.

**Alias:** `ls`

### Usage

```
jira transition list <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
jira transition list MYPROJ-42
jira transition list MYPROJ-42 --json
```

---

## jira transition do

Trigger a transition on an issue by name or transition ID.

**Alias:** `jira issue transition`

### Usage

```
jira transition do <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` | | Target status name or transition name |
| `--id` | | Transition ID (alternative to `--to`) |
| `--comment` | `-b` | Add a comment during transition |
| `--resolution` | | Set resolution field (e.g. `Fixed`, `Won't Fix`, `Duplicate`) |
| `--assignee` | | Reassign issue during transition |

### Examples

```bash
# Interactive picker (no --to flag)
jira transition do MYPROJ-42

# By status name
jira transition do MYPROJ-42 --to "In Progress"
jira transition do MYPROJ-42 --to "Done" --resolution "Fixed"

# By transition ID
jira transition do MYPROJ-42 --id 31

# With a comment
jira transition do MYPROJ-42 --to "Closed" \
  --comment "Deployed to production on $(date)"

# Close a batch of issues via JQL
jira issue list --jql "project = MYPROJ AND status = 'Ready to Close'" \
  --json --jq '.[].key' \
  | xargs -I{} jira transition do {} --to "Done" --confirm
```
